messages.author: 2f766424b1472aa7
messages.subject: MGCFA: could not compute standard errors! Unidentified model
parts:
Hi, I am using lavaan to do an MGCFA:

FCGR2 <- 'Q1 =~ V5 + V6 +V7 + V8 + V9
                Q7  =~ V22 + V23 + V24 + V25 + V26 + V27
                Q17 =~ V42 + V43 + V44 + V45
                '
FCGR.fit2 <- lavaan::sem(model = FCGR2, data = newsem4, group = "Age")

summary(FCGR.fit1, fit.measures = TRUE)

Here Age is the categorical factor for grouping:
(0,30]  : 397  
(30,40] : 827  
(40,50] :1117  
(50,60] : 946  
(60,100]: 917 

But I received this message in the console:
Warning message:
In lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats,  :
  lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors!
  lavaan NOTE: this may be a symptom that the model is not identified.

Can anyone please help me with this problem?

Thanks a lot!

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: MGCFA: could not compute standard errors! Unidentified model
parts:
Your model (for a single group) looks like this:

#The proposed model 1
FCGR <- 'Q1 =~ V5 + V6 +V7 + V8 + V9
Q2 =~ V10 + V11 + V12 + V13
Q4 =~ V14 + V15 + V16 + V17

Q19 =~ V42 + V43+ V44+V45+V46+V47
V6 ~~ V7
V12 ~~ V13
V23 ~~ V24
V23 ~~ V25
V24 ~~ V25
V42 ~~ V43
V42 ~~ V44
V42 ~~ V45
V42 ~~ V46
V42 ~~ V47
V43 ~~ V44
V43 ~~ V45
V43 ~~ V46
V43 ~~ V47
V44 ~~ V45
V44 ~~ V46
V44 ~~ V47
V45 ~~ V46
V45 ~~ V47
V46 ~~ V47
'

This model is not identified, because you correlate ALL the residual
errors of the indicator of the 'Q19' latent variable.

You should only add a few (if any) residual errors to your model, and
only if you have substantive reason for it.

Yves.
